goals.goal: The product with digital elements is designed, developed, and produced to limit its attack surfaces, including external interfaces, and to reduce the impact of an incident using appropriate exploitation-mitigation mechanisms and techniques, demonstrated through the design/development documentation and risk-assessment record
goals.source: CRA Annex I Part I (2)(j); CRA Annex I Part I (2)(k); CRA Art. 13(1); CRA Art. 13(2)
goals.adjustment: Restated for 8-FTE rule-based SaaS manufacturer (no AI/ML, no DORA, no AI Act); CRA participation is partial (outcome-level mandates only, no coding-standard prescription in OJ); coding-practices baseline from industry frameworks demonstrated against Annex I Part I (2)(j)+(k) via Annex VII §2/§3 records; HL SO not activated (single-regulation scope, no Conditional-Y overlap)
